description: Photograph of Hojancha (Seed and First Leaf) by Mym Tuma. Mym Tuma, also known as Marilynn Thuma, corresponded with Georgia O'Keeffe from 1964 to 1973. This photograph, and fourteen others, were probably enclosed in a letter from Marilynn Thuma dated September 4, 1970.
title: Hojancha (Seed and First Leaf) by Mym Tuma
